_doc: Layout edits on top of the frozen v5 map, applied by tools/design/dao_do_rework/content/export_game.py when it writes assets/data/dao_do_map.json. The frozen map and its content stay the design source; this file only moves nodes, removes nodes and re-links edges. Made 2026-11-20 at the user's request after the node-art pass (icons overlapped): (1) the four islands (Sun, Moon, Shadow Shrine, Thunder) scaled 1.6x about their centres and moved outward so their inner edge stays; (2) the Moon lotus (cluster 9782) scaled 1.5x and lifted 2 units, its two lines to the crescent cut from 6 to 3 small nodes each; (3) 51 crowded pieces scaled about their road entry just enough to clear; (4) 85 nodes nudged away from the node they touched (median 0.13, max 0.60 units). Overlaps at the viewer's icon sizes: 1,166 before, 0 after. Road nodes 637 and 667 (the bridges from the ring to the Moon horns) were placed by hand at (+-35.08, -116.5), just outside each horn: moved with the Moon, or left in place, their links crossed the Moon's swirls or roads.
